subject: Pricing deck visibility & decision cadence — inference evaluation
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Nguyen <sam.nguyen@averytech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing deck + estimate for the inference evaluation (AVY-042)

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through AveryTech's evaluation goals. Per our conversation I attached the pricing deck and a draft estimate that maps the capacity profile we discussed (100 concurrent inference streams, P95 latency target, 24/7 ingest). Highlights:

- Two recommended tiers (Dedicated reserved for peak, Hosted for baseline spiky traffic)
- Estimated monthly cost with expected batching savings and prefix cache applied
- Optional private VPC add-on and SOC 2+ audit support

Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_Deck_v3.pdf, AVY-042_estimate.xlsx

Next steps I proposed on the call:
1) You review the attached and confirm rough budget alignment
2) We set a 20–30 min walkthrough to go line-by-line on the estimate and discuss any adjustments
3) If budget and SSO/KMS requirements look good, we can schedule a short pilot (2-week dedicated window)

Would you be available for a walkthrough next week? I pushed a few tentative 30-minute slots into the Calendly link in the deck, but happy to coordinate here — proposed windows: Wed 12/16 10–11am PT or Thu 12/17 2–3pm PT.

If it helps, I can also prepare a short comparison row for your Graviton-based fleet vs. our recommended quantization profile.

Thanks —

Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0122

Hi Sam —

Wanted to follow up one more time as I'm syncing with our CS and Solutions teams on expected start dates for pilots in January. A couple quick questions to help prioritize:

- On a 1–5 scale, how would you rate the priority of this project for the next 60 days? (1 = low, 5 = critical)
- Is procurement the gating item, or are there outstanding technical clarifications we should address first?

If procurement is the main blocker, I can supply a one-page purchase summary tailored to AveryTech's template and loop in our legal ops to speed signature. If technical questions are outstanding, I'm happy to do a 20-minute run-through with our Solutions Eng (Lauren) to validate latency numbers and integration patterns.

Would a 20-minute call this week (Tue 12/15 11:00am PT) work for you? If not, tell me a couple times that do and I'll book.

Thanks for the update,
Mateo
